summary: RELX PLC announced a non-discretionary share buyback programme to repurchase ordinary shares between 7 September 2026 and 21 October 2026, with a spend of £125 million. This follows a completed £150 million programme on 4 September 2026, both part of a £2.25 billion 2026 buyback allocation. Shares will be held in treasury to reduce capital, within the general authority granted at the AGM on 23 April 2026 (up to 145.1 million shares). J.P. Morgan Securities plc will manage purchases independently under preset parameters. What to watch: execution pace and any changes to capital return policy.
